qs.s: Après la course, il essayait de calmer sa ___.
qs.en: After the race, he was trying to calm his breathing.

qs.s: Le yoga apprend à mieux maîtriser sa ___.
qs.en: Yoga teaches you to better control your breathing.

qs.s: Le médecin a écouté ___ respiration du patient.
qs.en: The doctor listened to the patient's breathing.

qs.s: Elle a pris ___ grande respiration avant de plonger.
qs.en: She took a deep breath before diving.

qs.s: En France, les lycéens passent leur ___ à la fin de la classe de terminale.
qs.en: In France, high school students take their baccalaureate exam at the end of their final year.

qs.s: Ma sœur a obtenu son ___ avec la mention très bien.
qs.en: My sister passed her baccalaureate with highest honors.

qs.s: En France, ___ baccalauréat marque la fin des études secondaires.
qs.en: In France, the baccalaureate marks the end of secondary education.

qs.s: Il a obtenu ___ baccalauréat scientifique avec mention.
qs.en: He obtained a science baccalaureate with honors.

qs.s: Le chat ronronnait sous la douce ___ de sa maîtresse.
qs.en: The cat purred under its owner's gentle caress.

qs.s: L'enfant s'endormit après la ___ de sa mère sur son front.
qs.en: The child fell asleep after his mother's caress on his forehead.

qs.s: Elle sentit ___ caresse légère du vent dans ses cheveux.
qs.en: She felt a light caress of the wind in her hair.

qs.s: ___ caresse de sa main resta gravée dans sa mémoire.
qs.en: The caress of his hand remained etched in her memory.
